title: Design System: MyApp (Next.js + Material UI + Storybook)

seed.note: DEFAULT_SEED in src/theme.ts; input to SchemeTonalSpot, never painted directly.

title-large.purpose: Card titles, hero side heading, app name; last step of the brand face.

body-large.purpose: Running copy; hero copy capped at 540px.

code.purpose: Import paths, tone numbers, inline file names.

shadows.name: fab-level-3
shadows.purpose: Extended FAB only (MUI shadows[3], M3 FAB spec). Every other surface uses tonal tiers.

motion.name: ease-emphasized
motion.purpose: Shared easing: app bar background, switch thumb, swatch hover, seed reveal.

motion.name: app-bar-scroll
motion.purpose: Top app bar background swap from surface to surface-container on scroll.

motion.name: seed-reveal
motion.purpose: Preset re-seed: circular clip-path View Transition expanding from the chosen swatch. Custom input, reduced motion, or no support: instant.

motion.name: palette-fade
motion.purpose: Tonal palette cells crossfade on re-seed.

components.name: Filled Button
components.description: Primary action; full pill, no elevation.

components.name: Outlined Button

components.name: Seed Picker
components.description: Five tri-segment preset swatches plus a dashed custom-seed swatch (native color input). Presets reveal via circular View Transition; custom applies instantly.
components.css: .ds-seeds { display: flex; gap: 12px; color: #3d4279; } .ds-swatch { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: 2px; transition: outline-color 150ms, transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-swatch > svg:first-child:not([width]) { width: 92%; height: 92%; } .ds-swatch:hover { transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-swatch--on { outline-color: currentColor; } .ds-swatch:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed currentColor; } .ds-swatch--custom { box-sizing: border-box; border: 2px dashed currentColor; }

narrative.overview:
This is Material 3 Tonal, built on MUI. A single seed color (`DEFAULT_SEED` in `src/theme.ts`) goes through `SchemeTonalSpot` from `@material/material-color-utilities`, which generates every color role for both light and dark. The world is meant to read as a finished, recognizably Material 3 app: lavender-tinted surfaces, pill-shaped actions, soft container fills, and a brand face with rounded terminals. The seed itself never appears raw. TonalSpot tames `#4F5BD5` into a muted indigo primary, and that restraint is the house tone.

Density is comfortable. Content sits in a `lg` container (max 1280px) with generous panel padding. Depth comes from tonal surface-container tiers, not from shadows. The swatch mark (primary across the top half, secondary and tertiary in the bottom quarters) serves as both logo and seed control, so you can see the theme mechanism directly. Light, dark and system schemes are class-driven. Storybook wraps every story in the same `SeedThemeProvider`, so the app and Storybook render identically.
keyCharacteristics: Every color is a generated role. The frontmatter hexes are the default seed's light-scheme output, not constants.
Depth comes from surface-container tiers. The extended FAB is the single shadowed component.
Corners are assigned by family: 4 fields, 8 chips/menus, 16 cards/FAB/alerts, 28-32 hero panel, full pills for buttons.
Google Sans Flex (rounded, `ROND` 100 at display sizes) for brand type, Roboto for plain type, Google Sans Code for code.
Re-seeding with a preset reveals the new theme as a circle expanding from the chosen swatch.

rules.name: The One Seed Rule
rules.body: Components reference roles (`primary.container`, `background.containerLow`), never hex values. Any seed, including a custom one, has to re-theme the whole surface and Storybook with no code change.

rules.name: The Container-Pair Rule
rules.body: A colored fill always takes its matching on-color: container with onContainer, main with contrastText. Never mix pairs across roles.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Buttons and labels are never uppercased (`textTransform: none`). M3 label weight comes from 500 weight, not from case.

rules.name: The Brand-Above-Title Rule
rules.body: The brand face stops at Title Large. Everything smaller is Roboto.

rules.name: The Tier-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is shown by moving up a surface-container tier. The FAB is the exception and stays the only one: no new component gets a shadow unless the M3 spec for that component calls for one.

rules.name: The Scroll-Under Rule
rules.body: The top app bar sits on the page surface at rest. It changes to surface-container only once content scrolls under it (MUI `useScrollTrigger`, threshold 0, 200ms `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` background transition). It is not surface-container at rest.

dos: Do reference palette roles (`primary.container`, `background.containerLow`, `secondary.onContainer`) so any seed re-themes the component.
Do pair every fill with its on-color (container/onContainer, main/contrastText).
Do express depth by stepping up a surface-container tier.
Do use the corner families: 4 fields, 8 chips/menus, 16 cards/FAB/alerts, full pills for buttons.
Do use the tonal button for secondary emphasis between filled and outlined.
Do keep the brand face to Title Large and above, and set code in Google Sans Code.
Do keep the app bar on the page surface at rest and switch it to surface-container on scroll.
Do keep motion on `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` and honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't hardcode hex values from this file into components. They are one seed's output.
Don't add shadows to cards, buttons, menus or the app bar. The extended FAB's level-3 shadow is the single sanctioned one.
Don't uppercase button or chip labels.
Don't use tertiary by default. It is an explicit, contrasting choice.
Don't put more than one primary-container hero block on a page.
